svg.text: Paired FPGA cycle saving by input
Sorted 360 unique inputs; fixed Exit 2 minus adaptive, positive means adaptive is faster.
DE0-CV | C3 v2 build 43334531 | 360 frozen inputs | one unverified power session | EMPIRICAL_ONLY
Not cold-boot/generalization evidence. No FPGA JTAG signoff, WCET, or 1 pp noninferiority claim.
